text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. That was a splendid 
display of skill, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list:
I was so nervous wondering if it would 
work out...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I saw it. The silhouette of an evil 
entity attempting to obstruct my prayers 
and carry this child away.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Evil intent and holy prayer. The clash 
between these two opposing forces 
manifested in that extreme offensive and 
defensive battle.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, in the end, it is a holy heart 
that prevails. This outcome is surely the 
result of your sincere feelings, Trainer, 
aligning with the prayers of a Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. May the blessings of 
heaven be upon you—
